nodes.title: Paper and Ruler Placements
nodes.description: Capture-owned original frames, identified reference points, measured dimensions and repeatable observation revisions.
instructions: Open a capture and choose Calibration, then Paper / Ruler References. Review the recorded camera and optical settings.
Keep the reference stationary across camera views. Name each new placement, mark the same physical corners and save a revision.

nodes.title: Reviewed Camera Layout
nodes.description: Canonical fixed-intrinsics estimation with explicit world anchor, fit/validation residuals and preserved lens distortion.
instructions: Use compatible lens profiles and overlapping paper observations from multiple cameras and placements. Confirm the ball/target anchor.
Estimate camera positions, inspect independent validation and limitations, then use the reviewed layout for Match. Changed optics require a new session.

nodes.title: Capture Library
nodes.description: Find, import, open and edit captures; save swing notes and manage archive/storage.
instructions: Import existing videos, or select a recorded capture and open it.
Name the swing and add notes so you can recognize this take later.

nodes.title: Swing Selection
nodes.description: Preview source frames, mark in/out and crop before inference.
instructions: Play or step through the recording to find the swing. Select its first and last frames.
Crop around the player if needed, then Save. Keep the full range to use the entire recording.
When analysis already exists, the editor offers a separate editable copy so earlier results remain available.

nodes.title: Coaching References
nodes.description: Saved lines, arrows, circles, ellipses and rectangles in original camera pixels.
instructions: Choose a camera view and pause at the frame you want to discuss.
Draw lines, arrows, circles, ellipses or rectangles. Select a shape to adjust it, or use Undo.
Save your references before returning. Use the editor’s export controls to share an annotated image or video.

nodes.title: Expert Reference Library
nodes.description: Import linked 2D video or validated C3D/model marker motion with explicit units, axes and joint names.
instructions: Import an expert video or a C3D/model motion file. Check the units and axes when importing motion.
Give the reference a recognizable name and notes. Choose it in Expert Comparison.

nodes.title: Expert Comparison
nodes.description: Place an expert video or model, pair swing events, and review through the selected camera.
instructions: Choose an expert reference and align it with the player in the camera view.
Pair matching swing events to synchronize playback, then adjust placement and opacity.
Save the comparison before returning. Review the alignment carefully before exporting it.

nodes.title: Comparison Deliverables
nodes.description: Encoded comparison video and portable evidence sidecar.

nodes.title: Attributed Club Catalog
nodes.description: Optional component quantities, source claims and build revisions.

nodes.title: Club Catalog Exchange
nodes.description: Validated JSON/CSV and offline manufacturer examples; source review preserves player overrides.

nodes.title: My Clubs
nodes.description: Catalog/custom clubs, notes, archive and capture-owned equipment snapshots.
instructions: Search the catalog or add a custom club. Enter only the specifications you know; keep estimates and unknown values explicit.
Assign the selected club to this capture. Editing your bag later preserves the capture’s saved club details.
Skip this step if the club details are unavailable. Current body models record equipment context without applying a club constraint.

nodes.title: Model Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze reference motion with the shared timeline, drawings, appearance and metric references.
instructions: Select a motion asset in the reference library and choose Analyze Model.
Adjust club visibility, ellipsoids, opacity, placement and handedness; add drawings or 3D references.
Save the portable analysis recipe or export a still or video. The camera is virtual.

nodes.title: Metric Reference Planes and Points
nodes.description: Scene-bound reference geometry in metres with explicit ADR-0041 axes.
instructions: Open 3D References in model analysis or comparison.
Enter point coordinates or plane origin, normal, extent and opacity in the displayed world frame.
Save after reviewing camera and scene identity; changed evidence requires review.

nodes.title: Reuse Calibration for a New Swing
nodes.description: Explicit review and a portable copy of the original camera estimate and observation evidence.
instructions: Open the new swing and choose Calibration, then Reuse a Camera Layout. Select an original reviewed estimate from an earlier capture.
Review the source settings and confirm unchanged optics, camera positions, ball origin and target direction. Use for This Swing retains source evidence; changed conditions require recalibration.
